hooks.command: if grep -qE 'git( -C [^ ]+)? commit'; then if command -v powershell.exe >/dev/null; then powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/check-before-commit.ps1"; else echo 'Repo checks are Windows-only (no powershell.exe here); the Check workflow runs them on push' >&2; fi; fi
